fact: ANSD's national data archive lists the fifth general population and housing census, Senegal 2023 (RGPH-5), as a catalogued dataset with licensed files and 19,910 views; no enumeration date is given, so the year is used.
ANSD's national data archive lists the 2013 general census of population, housing, agriculture and livestock (RGPHAE) as a catalogued dataset with licensed files and 4,808,203 views.

ANSD's archive lists the national employment survey (ENES) first quarter 2025 as a dataset with licensed files, last modified 21 October 2025; the page gives no release date, so the last-modified date is used.

The ANEC director general cites RGPH-5 data showing 5.3% of the population and 8.9% of under-5s have no birth certificate, so the fifth census has been taken; the document gives no enumeration date and the year 2023 is inferred from his comparison with 2023 survey data.
The document cites EDS Continue 2023 as establishing that 81.4% of under-5s are registered; it gives no release date, so the document's published date is used.
The DGPSN presentation gives Senegal's population as 18,000,000 individuals from the 2023 census.
The article says the ENTICS sample was drawn from the base of the fifth Population and Housing Census (RGPH-5) of 2023.
